# YourSqlDba

> Open-source SQL Server maintenance and automation toolkit. YourSqlDba installs a dedicated database containing T-SQL procedures, functions, jobs, and supporting objects for backups, integrity checks, index and statistics maintenance, cleanup, diagnostics, delegated database operations, and restore-based migration workflows.

Documentation: https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/
French documentation: https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/fr/
Source code: https://github.com/pelsql/YourSqlDba
Complete documentation as Markdown: https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/sitemap.xml

## Start here

- [Who YourSqlDba is for](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/Who-YourSqlDba-is-for.html): Project goals, audience, design, and capabilities
- [Getting started](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/getting-started.html): Architecture, default jobs, and a DBA quick start
- [Installation and upgrade](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/installation.html): Prerequisites, installation, initial setup, and upgrades
- [Configuration](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/configuration.html): Maintenance parameters, database selection, scheduling, and retention
- [Diagnostics and reporting](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/diagnostics.html): History, errors, Database Mail, and wait statistics
- [Version history and release notes](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/releases.html): Releases and links to install scripts

## Maintenance reference

- [Maintenance overview](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/maintenance/): Main maintenance documentation
- [Maint.YourSqlDba_DoMaint](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/maintenance/your-sql-dba-domaint.html): Primary maintenance procedure, parameters, actions, filters, and examples
- [Delegated database management](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/maintenance/delegated-database-management.html): Controlled backup, restore, refresh, cleanup, and application-upgrade operations for non-sysadmin users
- [External backup solutions](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/maintenance/external-backup-solutions.html): Integration with third-party backup products and CommVault restore generation
- [Mirror, standby, and migration testing](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/maintenance/mirror-standby-migration.html): Restore-based copies, migration testing, and cutover
- [Mirroring procedure reference](https://pelsql.github.io/YourSqlDba/maintenance/mirroring-reference.html): Detailed mirroring and migration procedure reference
